Account Manager - Media

The Dynata Account Manager is primarily responsible for ensuring outstanding customer results in their day-to-day project-level needs. Moving beyond responsiveness, the Account Manager builds relationships, anticipates client needs and constantly seek to find creative solutions. The Account Manager is the front-line contact for our clients and has the responsibility to be able to understand the client need and coordinate the resources to solve the client issues quickly and efficiently.

The Role
The purpose of this role is to be a client leader in the Dynata Media division. The Media group provides consumer insights, campaign effectiveness and audience activation solutions to Dynata clients.

Dynata is well known in the research industry with over 3,000 global clients. Being an Account Manager within the Dynata Media division represents an opportunity to sell novel and differentiated products to our client partners that span media publishers, large corporate brands, and advertising agencies across the United States and Canada.. The ideal candidate will be self-motivated, intellectually curious, a thoughtful and pragmatic problem-solver that can champion the needs of our esteemed clients and has an innate ability to work cross-functionally with an array of internal and external constituents.

As a complement to the client service skill set required for success in this role, the ideal candidate will come with experience in fields like marketing science, analytics, strategic insights, or business intelligence.

What You’ll Do as an Account Manager:

  • Be the primary point of contact for a list of key existing customers

  • Is expert at discovery and understands the client’s needs beyond the details of a quote and leverages knowledge to uncover additional needs we can meet.

  • Have responsibility for ensuring attentive customer service and building enduring relationships with our clients

  • Partner with Account Director on key accounts to ensure sales targets are met and help identify other solutions from the product suite that could proffer value

  • Manage day-to-day account activities, partnering across departments to ensure smooth delivery.

  • Highlight key insights on projects while they are in field by reviewing data accessible through near real-time proprietary tools, and keep client up to date on performance of projects

  • Serve as an internal extension for key clients and advocate on their behalf as needed

  • Follow industry trends that may affect our client’s business

Essential Skills

  • Proven ability to deliver consistent results against financial targets over an extended period of time.

  • Knowledge and sales experience with media ad tech /ad measurement products and services

  • Hands-on approach - not afraid to maneuver through all aspects of the business (sales, strategy, ops, marketing, product development, recruitment etc.)

  • Influential and comfortable serving as a trusted and consultative resource

  • Aptitude for interpreting data and adept at working with numbers

  • Able to work efficiently and get things done quickly

  • Strong communication, oratory, and time management skills

  • Proficient computer skills in Microsoft office tools and ability to master other needed business tools e.g., Maconomy, SPSS, Survey Reporter).

  • Bachelor's degree and 3+ years working in research, marketing sciences, business intelligence, strategic insights and/or analytics at a brand, agency, publisher, platform, or advertising technology firm

How To Be Successful in the Role

  • A flair for nurturing and building relationships with clients and internal stakeholders

  • Creative problem solving

  • Able to distill and communicate complex solutions

  • Strong understanding of market research and consumer privacy issues

  • A high intellect individual who combines analytical excellence, superior communication skills (presentation and written) and an ability to build strong client relationships

  • Organized but flexible and comfortable working in a dynamic industry with exacting quality requirements

  • Knowledge of basic statistical methods used in research, polling, measurement and data analysis

Dynata is a global leader in permission based digital data collection and reporting. Dynata is headquartered in Connecticut and has over 4,000 employees worldwide and office offices in Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.

At Dynata, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and communities in which we live and serve. Dynata welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. We are committed to an inclusive work culture for all our employees. Accommodations by request can be made for all aspects of the selection process.

Dynata is also an affirmative action employer OE/Minority/Female/Veteran/Disabled/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity

The salary range for this position in is $75k - $90k/yr (base + variable); with additional upside bonuses available based on territory performance. A discretionary incentive program may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical and other benefits.

raw.excerpt: About First Connect:First Connect Insurance Services is a digital platform providing independent insurance agents access to top US carriers and the optionality necessary to grow their businesses.
raw.description:
About First Connect:

First Connect Insurance Services is a digital platform providing independent insurance agents access to top US carriers and the optionality necessary to grow their businesses. Agents can work with over 150 carriers, selling various insurance policies, including home, auto, small business, and more. We're on a mission to overhaul the technology agents have access to, putting consumer-grade software at their fingertips. We've got thousands of active agents with hundreds joining monthly and we plan to accelerate our growth.

Role Overview:

The HubSpot Automation Specialist is the dedicated builder behind First Connect's carrier and partner automation, a fast-growing portfolio of 600+ workflows that power how independent agents get access to carriers and partners on our platform. These are highly complex, multi-branch automated processes with deep conditional logic, cross-object dependencies, time-based delays, and custom code actions. This role owns that workflow library and supports inbound workflow needs from Sales, Support, and Account Management teams to drive operational automation and efficiency. Working in close collaboration with the CRM & Automation Admin, Director of Agency Marketing Operations, and Product team stakeholders, the Specialist executes on defined specs with precision and a deep understanding of CRM infrastructure and HubSpot objects, including custom objects.

What You’ll Do:

  • Carrier Automation Ownership: Build and maintain existing complex partner workflows including new workflow construction, ongoing optimization, error monitoring, and resolution of workflow failures or enrollment issues. Many of these are large, multi-branch workflows with dozens of decision paths, cross-object dependencies, and intricate enrollment logic that require careful design and testing.
  • Sales, Support & Account Management Workflow Execution: Build and deploy HubSpot automations that operationalize defined processes for Sales, Support, and Account Management teams (notifications, task creation, property updates, list management, ticket routing, deal automation, pipeline stage progression, lifecycle stage transitions, and lead scoring logic) to drive operational automation and efficiency across teams.
  • Product & HubSpot Integration: Work closely with Product team stakeholders to ensure data sync and operational flows between Product systems and HubSpot are functioning correctly. Maintain integrations across Zapier, webhooks, and direct APIs, troubleshooting sync issues and building workflows that support cross-system handoffs.
  • Workflow Maintenance & QA: Monitor active workflows for enrollment errors, action failures, and unintended behavior. Perform root-cause troubleshooting, implement fixes, and escalate complex architectural issues to the CRM & Automation Admin.
  • Workflow Improvement & Consolidation: Proactively identify opportunities to improve, simplify, and consolidate workflows. Recommend better ways to structure automation logic, reduce redundancy, and optimize the workflow library for performance and maintainability.
  • Documentation & Governance: Maintain clear documentation for every workflow built or modified, including purpose, enrollment criteria, branching logic, and dependencies. Adhere to established naming conventions, folder structures, and governance standards.

Must Haves:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building complex HubSpot workflows in a Marketing, Sales, or Revenue Operations environment.
  • HubSpot certifications and Academy courses taken in Workflows.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Management Information Systems, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Deep understanding of CRM infrastructure and all HubSpot objects, including standard objects (contacts, companies, deals, tickets) and custom objects, with proven experience working with these objects inside workflows.
  • Expert proficiency in HubSpot Workflows, including object-based automations, webhooks, custom code actions, branching logic, and cross-object property syncing.
  • Strong knowledge of HubSpot ticket pipelines, deal pipelines, and lifecycle stage automation.
  • Demonstrated ability to execute accurately against written specifications and to recommend workflow improvements based on patterns observed across the platform.
  • Strong attention to detail with naming conventions, folder structure, enrollment criteria, and downstream impact of changes.
  • Comfort working through a high-volume request queue with shifting priorities.
  • Clear written communication for documentation and ticket/request updates.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience with HubSpot custom code actions.
  • Prior experience in insurance, financial services, or another regulated B2B environment.

Benefits & Perks:

First Connect treats its team members with the same level of dedication and care as we do our customers, which is why we're fortunate to provide our team with:

  • Multiple medical plans to choose from and 100% employer-covered dental; vision plans for our team members and their families.
  • We also offer a 401(k) retirement plan, short; long-term disability, employer-paid life insurance, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) for health and dependent care, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Work-From-Home Stipend – Employer-provided WFH equipment and an $85 monthly expense stipend to ensure you're set up for success.
  • Equity - This position is eligible for equity compensation
  • Training and Career Growth - Training and internal career growth opportunities
  • Flexible Time Off - You know when and how you should recharge

The base pay range for the role is $75,000 – $85,000. Exact compensation may vary based on several job-related factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to: skill set, experience, education/training, location, business needs, and market demands.

First Connect is an equal-opportunity employer, and we are committed to building a team culture that celebrates diversity and inclusion.

Applicants are considered solely based on their qualifications, without regard to an applicant's disability or need for accommodation. Any First Connect applicant who requires reasonable accommodations during the application process should contact the First Connect People Team to make the need for an accommodation known.

raw.description:
It’s not just about the tech; it’s about the people!

At Career TEAM, we work to “accelerate the human condition.” Working on our state-of-the-edge portal, Career EDGE, you will change lives—and that’s just the beginning! You'll be working with new technologies on enterprise products that serve a diverse population across the U.S. As a founding member of our newly forming team, you'll have the opportunity to grow and shape it as we adeptly traverse the complex digital landscape of generative AI, cloud computing, and cutting-edge technologies.

Specifically, what you will do

You will build amazing things using MongoDB, Next.js, Nest.js, and Node.js, alongside DevOps tools and practices. On any given day, you'll be coding, reviewing, deploying, testing, and iterating—this is our bread and butter. You'll participate in regular Scrum ceremonies while continuously innovating and optimizing for speed, scalability, and security. You'll also help architect systems to ensure high availability and resilience, leveraging AWS services to build scalable cloud solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Full-Stack Development: Use technologies like Node.js, MongoDB, Next.js, and Nest.js to develop robust applications.
  • DevOps and CI/CD Pipelines: Develop and manage CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and YAML for seamless deployment.
  • Containerization and Orchestration: Leverage Docker and Kubernetes for containerization and orchestration of applications.
  • Cloud Infrastructure on AWS: Implement scalable DevOps solutions using AWS services like EC2, S3, Lambda, and RDS.
  • Security Best Practices: Build secure, robust web applications with a strong focus on security standards and protocols.
  • Architectural Collaboration: Work with cross-functional teams to make architectural decisions for system scalability and performance.
  • RESTful Services Development: Design, develop, test, and deploy RESTful APIs and microservices.
  • Infrastructure Automation: Develop processes for infrastructure automation using Terraform, Jenkins, and Docker.
  • Real-Time Problem Solving: Solve complex problems in real-time, ensuring high performance and reliability.
  • Monitoring and Logging: Implement monitoring and logging solutions to ensure system health and performance.

Ideal Candidate Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in computer science, information technology, or engineering.
  • Experience:
    • 2+ years of experience developing with Node.js/MERN stack or equivalent.
    • 2+ years of core web app development experience (front-end and back-end).
    • 2+ years of CI/CD and/or DevOps related work experience.
  • Technical Skills:
    • AWS Familiarity: Experience with AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, and CloudFormation.
    • Containerization: Proficient with Docker and Kubernetes for application deployment and management.
    • DevOps Tools: Knowledge of DevOps principles and experience with CI/CD tools like GitHub Actions.
    • Configuration Management: Working experience with YAML for configuration management.
    • Infrastructure as Code: Familiarity with Terraform for managing cloud infrastructure.
    • Version Control: Proficient with Git and GitHub for code management and collaboration.
  • Programming Languages:
    • Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript.
    • Working experience with PHP is a strong plus.
  • Security and Compliance:
    • Experience in secure software development and architecture.
    • Familiarity with security best practices and protocols.
  • Additional Tools:
    • Exposure to VSCode, Postman, Jira, Jenkins, and Docker.
    • Experience with monitoring tools like AWS CloudWatch or ELK Stack.
  • Soft Skills:
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
    • Effective collaboration and communication abilities.
    • Ability to work in a fast-paced, agile environment.
  • Platforms: Experience working on multiple operating systems (Linux, Windows).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • AWS Certifications: AWS Certified Developer, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or equivalent.
  • Serverless Architecture: Experience with AWS Lambda and serverless application development.
  • Microservices: Familiarity with microservices architecture and event-driven systems.
  • Networking and Security: Understanding of networking concepts, VPNs, and security protocols.
  • Performance Optimization: Experience in optimizing applications for maximum speed and scalability.
  • Community Contribution: Active participation in open-source projects or tech communities.

Why Join Us?

  • Impactful Work: Build something that truly matters, helping individuals across the U.S. succeed with cutting-edge technology.
  • Professional Growth: Opportunities for learning and development in a fast-paced environment.
  • Innovative Environment: Be part of a team that's pushing the boundaries in AI, cloud computing, and software development.
  • Collaborative Culture: Work with a diverse and talented team that values collaboration and innovation.

About Career Team:
Founded in 1996, Career Team is socially conscious organization that seeks to close the nation’s opportunity divide through government-funded workforce development programs designed to help individuals get the skills, knowledge, and resources needed to obtain quality employment. In addition to administering these programs, Career Team develops and leverages cutting-edge software tools to ignite transformative change within the workforce development industry. Career Team is revolutionizing the operational landscape for workforce development professionals through its Career Edge platform, which includes state-of-the-art job training tools and advanced case management systems. For more information see www.careeredge.com and www.careerteam.com.

Career Team’s outstanding record has resulted in numerous honors, including:

  • Named by Inc. Magazine as one of America's 500 fastest growing privately held companies
  • Recipient of the US Chamber of Commerce Blue Chip Enterprise Award for innovation
  • Featured by 60 Minutes, CNN, Money Magazine, Inc. Magazine and the British Broadcasting Network as an innovative, government funded solutions program
  • Invited to the White House after being cited by the National Welfare-to-Work Partnership and National Alliance of Business as a top 10 US training provider

Career Team is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

Background Check Requirements. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check (including criminal, prior employment and education verification). Failure to satisfactorily complete the background check may affect the application status of applicants or continued employment of current employees who apply for the position.

raw.description:
About us

TeleTracking began with a simple but powerful belief that no one should wait for the care they need. More than a slogan, it’s a promise to continually improve healthcare.

TeleTracking builds groundbreaking technology incorporating deep clinical expertise. Our solutions are used in the nation’s largest healthcare systems and around the world to positively impact patients, families and communities.

What’s your contribution to the TeleTracking story?

When you choose to bring your passion and skills to help achieve our purpose, you’ll be part of a team that understands that there’s a human life behind every data point. Your skills, curiosity, and compassion—will help fuel our innovation and achieve the TeleTracking promise of revolutionizing modern healthcare.

About the Role

TeleTracking is hiring a quota-driven, new-logo sales leader to win enterprise deals across large U.S. health systems. This role is built for a true hunter: someone who creates opportunity where none exists, runs a disciplined outbound motion, earns access to senior executives, and closes complex, multi-stakeholder software deals. If you’re at your best when you’re opening doors, driving urgency, and owning the number—this is the role.

TeleTracking is the global leader in healthcare operations technology. Our Operations IQ platform gives health systems visibility and control across Access, Throughput, Ambulatory, and Data & Analytics—helping leaders improve patient experience, operational performance, and capacity to care. You’ll own a defined territory, build pipeline, and convert executive interest into signed agreements and expansion.

What you’ll do...

Own the Number (New Logo + Expansion)

  • Drive net-new logo acquisition and expansion across large U.S. health systems—owning territory strategy from target list to close.
  • Build pipeline through proactive outbound: prospecting, multi-threading, cold/warm outreach, partner/channel leverage, and executive networking.
  • Run a metrics-driven sales motion: pipeline coverage, stage conversion, close plans, and accurate forecasting—consistently delivering against aggressive targets.

Hunt, Qualify, and Close Enterprise Deals

  • Lead sharp discovery and qualification (pain, impact, access to power, timeline, budget) to determine if and how we win.
  • Translate operational friction into an outcome-driven business case (capacity, staffing productivity, patient flow, financial performance) and tie it to executive priorities.
  • Orchestrate complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles—multi-threading from C-suite to operational leaders, building close plans, managing risk, and negotiating to signature.
  • Compete to win—handle objections, differentiate vs. status quo and competitors, and create urgency that moves deals forward.

Build Executive Trust

  • Earn and expand relationships with C-suite and senior executives (CEO, CNO, COO, CIO, CDO, CMO) to unlock access, sponsorship, and decisions.
  • Lead executive meetings that land a point of view, quantify impact, and align on a mutual action plan toward purchase.
  • Connect TeleTracking to what leaders measure: patient experience, throughput, labor efficiency, capacity, and financial performance—then drive to decision.

Build Internally, While Building Externally

  • Lead the internal deal team (product, delivery, analytics, marketing, leadership) to scope solutions, build proposals, and remove obstacles to close.
  • Create clarity and urgency internally—set next steps, owners, and timelines; influence without authority to keep deals moving.
  • Bring crisp field intelligence—competitive insights, buyer objections, and win/loss learnings—to sharpen messaging and product direction.

Stay Ahead of the Market

  • Track healthcare industry trends including value‑based care, payer dynamics, regulatory shifts, and competitive movements.
  • Turn market intelligence into actionable strategies that sharpen TeleTracking’s competitive position.

What we’re looking for...

Experience & Profile

  • 15+ years in healthcare with significant experience carrying a quota in enterprise software/platform/analytics sales.
  • Documented new-logo wins selling complex solutions into large health systems (C-suite + operational stakeholders), with a repeatable outbound playbook.
  • Strong grasp of U.S. healthcare operations and enterprise buying dynamics (security, legal, procurement), with confidence navigating contracting and negotiation.

Sales & Leadership Attributes

  • Relentless hunter mindset: disciplined prospecting cadence, strong activity-to-outcome conversion, and comfort hearing “no” on the way to “yes.”
  • Consultative seller who can uncover root causes quickly, build a quantified business case, and clearly articulate ROI.
  • Proven closer with a history of beating quota (e.g., top-performer rankings, President’s Club, consistent attainment) and winning in competitive bake-offs.
  • Collaborative deal leader who pulls the right people in at the right time—without slowing momentum.
  • Executive presence: able to command a room, run a tight meeting, and drive clear decisions with senior leaders.
  • Competitive and strategic—sets a point of view, anticipates objections, and controls the deal narrative.
  • Creates structure: builds account plans, mutual action plans, and close plans that make next steps unavoidable.
  • Leads from the front—personally driving late-stage deals, negotiations, and executive alignment to close.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business, or a related field - required
  • Master’s degree (MBA, MHA, or similar) - preferred

Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Benefits

  • Employee Medical/dental/vision premiums paid 100% - family members without coverage Medical 100% - small cost for dependents on dental and vision, which start from day one!
  • Life and AD&D
  • Flexible Spending Accounts: Medical, Dependent Care, and Transportation
  • 401 (k) Retirement Savings
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Military Paid Leave (up to 6 months of base salary while on military leave)
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid parental leave

Disclaimer:

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The term "qualified individual with a disability" means an individual with a disability who, with or without reasonable accommodation, can perform the essential functions of the position.

TeleTracking is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. TeleTracking recruits qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, age, ethnic or national origin, veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, marital status, or citizenship status.

Recruiting agencies, please do not submit unsolicited referrals for this or any open role. We have a roster of agencies with whom we partner, and we will not pay any fee associated with unsolicited referrals.

Who We Are

Sureify’s mission is to modernize the life insurance and annuity industry by helping carriers acquire, service, and engage their customers through any distribution channel. Sureify’s products empower life insurance carriers, agents, employees, and customers to have the digital experiences employees and consumers have come to expect in the rapidly advancing tech climate.

About the Role

Sureify is seeking a strategic and execution-oriented Vice President of Marketing to lead our marketing organization and elevate the Sureify brand as we continue to scale across the insurance and annuity technology market.

Reporting directly to the Chief Customer Officer, this leader will work in close partnership with Sales, Account Management, Product, and Executive Leadership to drive market awareness, pipeline growth, customer engagement, and brand differentiation. This role is ideal for a modern B2B SaaS marketing executive who thrives equally in strategy and execution — someone who can build the vision while also rolling up their sleeves to make it happen.

The VP of Marketing will lead a lean, high-performing team of individual contributors while serving as the creative and operational leader for the marketing function. This person will own the end-to-end marketing strategy across brand, demand generation, communications, events, content, digital presence, and sales enablement.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive marketing strategy aligned with company growth objectives and revenue goals.
  • Partner closely with the Chief Customer Officer and Sales leadership to drive pipeline generation, account expansion, customer engagement, and market positioning.
  • Serve as the strategic steward of the Sureify brand, ensuring consistency across messaging, visual identity, thought leadership, events, digital channels, and customer experiences.
  • Lead demand generation initiatives across inbound, outbound, ABM, partner marketing, events, and digital campaigns.
  • Own marketing operations, planning, forecasting, budgeting, reporting, and KPI measurement with a strong focus on efficiency and ROI.
  • Translate company strategy and product direction into compelling market narratives and differentiated positioning.
  • Oversee development of marketing content, sales enablement materials, website strategy, customer communications, and product marketing assets.
  • Act as a player-coach leader for a small team of marketing professionals and agency partners, balancing leadership, mentorship, and direct execution.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment between Marketing, Sales, Product, Account Management, and Executive Leadership.
  • Lead creative direction for campaigns, content, brand evolution, and market presence.
  • Establish scalable processes, workflows, and operational rigor within the marketing organization.
  • Analyze market trends, customer insights, competitive positioning, and campaign performance to continuously refine strategy.

Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience in B2B SaaS marketing, preferably within enterprise software, insurtech, fintech, or regulated industries.
  • Proven success leading both strategic marketing initiatives and hands-on execution in high-growth environments.
  • Experience partnering closely with Sales and Account Management organizations to drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of modern demand generation, account-based marketing, lifecycle marketing, and brand development.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and scale marketing functions with lean teams and limited resources.
  • Strong operational mindset with experience managing budgets, forecasting, KPIs, and marketing analytics.
  • Exceptional communication, storytelling, and presentation skills.
  • Experience leading creative direction and brand strategy across multiple channels.
  • Collaborative leadership style with the ability to influence across departments and executive stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, and modern marketing technology platforms.
  • Experience in insurance, financial services, or highly regulated industries is a plus.

What Success Looks Like

  • Increased brand awareness and market credibility within the insurance and annuity ecosystem.
  • Strong alignment between Marketing, Sales, and Account Management teams under a unified go-to-market strategy.
  • Consistent contribution to qualified pipeline growth and customer engagement.
  • A scalable marketing engine supported by clear metrics, operational discipline, and strong creative execution.
  • A high-performing, collaborative team culture focused on innovation, accountability, and impact.
Base annual salary
$210,000—$250,000 USD

Our Guiding Principles

Our products are for nothing if their creators are not fulfilled in their work. We want our employees to flourish at Sureify. We do not fawn over status or titles, instead, we honor effort and intelligence. The best idea wins no matter which colleague proposed it. We do not shortcut our mission with overblown claims or false promises. Sticking to the truth is both a strategy and a principle for us.

raw.title: Director of Global IT DevOps & AI Infrastructure
raw.excerpt: OpportunityEndeavour has an exciting opportunity for someone passionate about sustainability and eager to be part of an innovative company that’s on a journey to transform the world’s infrastructure.
raw.description:
Opportunity

Endeavour has an exciting opportunity for someone passionate about sustainability and eager to be part of an innovative company that’s on a journey to transform the world’s infrastructure. We are seeking a Director of Global IT DevOps & AI Infrastructure to take full ownership of how technology is built, deployed, secured, and scaled across the organization. This role is part of the support team that services the entire our Endeavour ecosystem and contributes to the overall health and success of the organization. This role goes beyond traditional IT. You will define and lead the end-to-end lifecycle of AI-powered digital products - from early-stage prototypes built in rapid-development environments to fully productionized, secure, and globally scalable platforms.

You will serve as the bridge between innovation and execution, ensuring that ideas don’t stall in experimentation but are operationalized into resilient, enterprise-grade systems - while also building and leading the teams, financial models, and integration strategies required to sustain long-term growth.

The Director of Global IT DevOps & AI Infrastructure needs to be agile, professional, and comfortable in a rapidly changing environment. The right person is trustworthy with confidential information, highly organized, self-motivated, has excellent communication skills, can think strategically, and works equally as well independently as with a team.

Endeavour is highly selective about the people we bring on board because our ecosystem depends on it. Change happens quickly here, and we must maintain a strong team of honest, communicative, collaborative, open-minded, strategic, reliable, and driven team members. We seek ultra-creatives and superstar performers with self-awareness, a sense of humility, and a hunger to make a positive impact in the world. Endeavour offers flexibility and endless growth opportunities to those who can harness their skills and talents and identify how and where to use them to add value. Our support team is the heart of the ecosystem. We’re a diverse group of bright, passionate, dedicated people, working together to make a real difference. Are you ready to join the journey?

Key Responsibilities

Include but are not limited to:

DevOps Ownership & Productionization of AI Systems

  • Lead the DevOps Strategy: Own the end-to-end strategy including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code (IaC), automated testing, and release management across all environments.
  • Standardize Development Pathways: Design and enforce a standardized path from prototype to staging to production, specifically for AI-generated applications, low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Lovable), and internal experimentation environments.
  • Establish Frameworks: Drive versioning, monitoring, rollback, and observability across both AI and traditional applications.
  • Implement Scalable Deployment Patterns: Utilize containers, serverless architectures, and microservices to support rapid iteration without sacrificing stability.

AI Platform Scaling & Lifecycle Management

  • Manage the AI Lifecycle: Architect prompt engineering environments, model orchestration, API integrations, and validation pipelines.
  • Evolve Prototypes: Define the pathway for AI prototypes to become internal tools, client-facing applications, and public-facing digital platforms.
  • Establish Governance: Build frameworks for model usage, cost control, performance monitoring, and output reliability.
  • Partner for Success: Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure AI solutions are production-ready, auditable, and aligned with business goals.

Cloud Architecture & Infrastructure Engineering

  • Optimize Cloud Environments: Own global cloud infrastructure (primarily Microsoft Azure) to ensure high availability, security, compliance, and horizontal scalability.
  • Design for Data: Architect infrastructure that supports data-intensive workloads, spatial systems, and AI-driven applications.
  • Build Resilient Systems: Ensure infrastructure is capable of supporting global users, partners, and mission-critical operations.

AI Security & Enterprise Governance

  • Secure AI Usage: Establish secure enterprise environments with data isolation, sandboxing, role-based access controls (RBAC), and secure API orchestration.
  • Protect Critical Assets: Define governance policies that protect proprietary infrastructure designs and sensitive client/operational data.
  • Ensure Compliance: Stay ahead of evolving standards regarding AI usage, data privacy, and enterprise risk management.

Team Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Build and Lead High-Performing Teams: Recruit, develop, and scale global DevOps, cloud engineering, and AI infrastructure teams, fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and operational excellence.
  • Define Operating Models: Establish clear roles, workflows, and performance expectations across distributed teams, contractors, and external partners.
  • Mentor and Develop Talent: Provide hands-on leadership, coaching, and career development for technical team members, ensuring long-term capability growth.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as a key partner to product, engineering, and business leaders to align technical execution with company priorities.

Budget Ownership & Financial Management

  • Own the Technology Budget: Develop and manage the global IT DevOps and cloud infrastructure budget, including forecasting, cost optimization, and vendor management.
  • Optimize Cloud & AI Spend: Implement cost governance strategies across cloud platforms, AI tooling, and third-party services to ensure efficient scaling.
  • Vendor & Partner Management: Evaluate, negotiate, and manage relationships with technology vendors, SaaS providers, and infrastructure partners.
  • ROI-Driven Decision Making: Ensure all infrastructure and AI investments are aligned with measurable business outcomes and scalability goals.

Integration Strategy & Systems Architecture

  • Lead Enterprise Integration Strategy: Define and oversee integration architecture across internal systems, third-party platforms, and partner ecosystems.
  • API & Data Ecosystem Ownership: Ensure seamless interoperability between AI platforms, ERP/supply chain systems, data visualization tools, and spatial technologies.
  • Enable Scalable Data Flows: Architect reliable, secure, and real-time data pipelines that support both operational systems and AI-driven insights.
  • Reduce Technical Fragmentation: Standardize integration patterns, tools, and governance to minimize redundancy and improve system cohesion across the organization.

Global Collaboration & Asset Ownership

  • Platform Enablement: Architect identity, access, and collaboration systems for a globally distributed workforce, ensuring seamless interaction between internal teams, partners, clients, and vendors.
  • Digital Infrastructure Ownership: Take full command of domain registries, DNS architecture, SSL lifecycle management, global routing, and web infrastructure.
  • Performance Assurance: Ensure all digital assets are secure, performant, and scalable across regions.

Education and Experience

  • 7+ years in IT DevOps, AI infrastructure or cloud engineering
  • 3+ years of leadership experience
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Management, or a related field.
  • Proven DevOps & Scaling Leadership: Experience owning DevOps and infrastructure in environments scaling from startup to enterprise ($100M–$1B+), with a track record of taking products from MVP to production-grade systems.
  • Team Leadership Experience: Demonstrated success building and leading high-performing global engineering or infrastructure teams in fast-paced environments.
  • Financial & Budget Ownership: Experience managing technology budgets, optimizing cloud spend, and aligning investments with business outcomes.
  • Deep Technical Expertise: Strong, hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure (or equivalent cloud platforms), CI/CD pipelines, containers, IaC, networking, DNS, and distributed systems.
  • Integration & Systems Thinking: Experience managing complex integrations across APIs, data visualization platforms, and ERP/supply chain technologies.
  • Strategic & Hands-On Operator: Capable of operating at an executive, architectural level while remaining comfortable rolling up your sleeves to build systems from scratch.

Specific Skills / Abilities

  • AI Ecosystem Fluency: Proven ability to operationalize LLMs, AI platforms, and rapid-development (low-code/no-code) ecosystems within an enterprise, deeply understanding AI reliability, evaluation, and scaling challenges.
  • Strategic & Hands-On Operator: Capable of operating at an executive, architectural level while remaining comfortable rolling up your sleeves to build systems from scratch.
  • Mission Alignment: Deeply motivated by applying technology and AI to solve real-world challenges in global water and energy infrastructure.

About Endeavour

Endeavour is taking on global challenges, and to create the appropriate global solutions is not easy. Our teams work extremely hard because we believe in Endeavour’s mission: to guarantee clean water and renewable energy to everyone, everywhere by decentralizing infrastructure, developing new technologies, & deploying energy, water, and waste treatment solutions that are more profitable than those that currently exist. We are a group of passionate change-makers who want to leave the world better than the way we found it. Endeavour prides itself on hiring talented, highly motivated people because that’s what our mission requires. There is a strong sense of camaraderie between good-natured people who bring their A-game to work every day to make a difference. To work at Endeavour is to know that you are part of something special—something bigger than yourself.

Position: Director of Global IT DevOps & AI Infrastructure

Full-Time or Part-Time: Full-Time

Reports to: Founder & CEO

Location: Remote - US

Kensington Grey is a leading influencer management firm specializing in representing content creators and influencers across various platforms. We work with top-tier talent to develop their brand, negotiate partnerships, and maximize their impact in the digital space. Our mission is to foster diversity, equity, and inclusion within the influencer landscape, amplifying underrepresented voices and driving meaningful change in the media and entertainment industry.

Position Overview:

Kensington Grey Agency Inc is hiring an experienced Talent Manager to join our expanding Influencer Management Agency. As a Talent Manager you will drive revenue from Kensington Grey's top spending brand partners and new revenue from business development to your roster of diverse social media influencers.

You are passionate about sales with brand and agency contacts and have a strong knowledge of the Influencer Marketing landscape. US social media agency experience is preferred but not mandatory.

Ideally, you are a self-driven creative thinker, who is prepared to roll up their sleeves and get the job done in a fast-paced, high growth environment. You're creative, open-minded, persistent and highly collaborative – all vital attributes in order to interact successfully with internal and external clients.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Facilitate consistent communication with talent and provide strategic career guidance.
  • Develop and conceptualize campaign strategies for all incoming opportunities for the Kensington Grey talent roster, aligning with budgetary constraints and individual strengths.

  • Cultivate and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including individuals and brands.
  • Proactively pitch opportunities to brands, tailored to the specific needs and goals of the talent.
  • Stay informed on industry trends, events, and partnership opportunities.
  • Identify and pursue opportunities for the growth and development of existing clients, while contributing to new program proposals and presentations.
  • Conduct research to provide insights on emerging talent and market trends.
  • Oversee and manage a personal roster of talent, ensuring all needs are met.
  • Establish and adhere to reasonable timelines for campaigns and deliverables.
  • Confirm all requirements, logistics, and expectations related to campaigns and activations.
  • Manage and maintain talent calendars, ensuring alignment with campaign objectives.
  • Set and manage client expectations effectively to ensure satisfaction and alignment.
  • Build and nurture relationships with talent, agencies, and brands to foster long-term collaboration.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of direct talent management experience
  • Proven experience in negotiating and securing endorsements and commercial deals.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience within the sports industry is a plus.
  • Extensive network of key executives and industry leaders.
  • Vast experience in securing six-figure and higher endorsements and partnerships.
  • Experience working with talent and brands along with excellent pitching abilities.
  • Strong marketing knowledge.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build and maintain strong relationships with clients, influencers, and team members.

At Kensington Grey, we believe in fostering a dynamic and rewarding work environment where talent thrives.

As a valued member of our team, you’ll enjoy:

✅ Competitive Compensation – We recognize your expertise with a salary and bonus structure that reflects your impact.

✅ Exciting Brand Collaborations – Work with top-tier talent, global brands, and high-profile campaigns that shape the entertainment and digital landscape.

✅ Innovative & Collaborative Culture – Join a passionate team that values creativity, fresh ideas, and a hands-on approach to success.

✅ Comprehensive Benefits Package – Enjoy health insurance, retirement plans, and additional perks that make a difference.

✅ Networking & Industry Access – Gain exclusive access to industry events, brand partnerships, and top-tier connections that fuel your professional growth.

Be part of a company that values your contributions and empowers you to make an impact.

Ready to grow with us?

Only applicants selected for interview will be contacted.

This job posting is for an existing vacancy and represents an immediate opportunity to join our team.

raw.title: Global Recruiter
raw.excerpt: Who we are Our mission at Capacity is to help teams do their best work through our AI-powered support automation platform.
raw.description:
Who we are

Our mission at Capacity is to help teams do their best work through our AI-powered support automation platform. Capacity provides everything you need to automate support and business processes in one powerful omni-channel platform.

We believe that each individual voice, perspective and background brings inherent value to enhance our product, serve our customers and generate more ideas to solve complex problems. By continuing to hire talented, driven and humble teammates, we have the opportunity to see Capacity become a premier brand enterprise SaaS platform.

Capacity has raised over $100 million dollars from over 150 investors, giving us the opportunity to make ambitious investments in our team and big bets on our future. Our total addressable market is enormous. Any company that wants to grow revenue, reduce costs, and improve customer and employee satisfaction is an opportunity for Capacity to shine.

Why this job is exciting

The role:

We are seeking a driven and technically fluent Recruiter to join our People Operations team. Capacity is an AI SaaS company in an active period of growth — and we need someone who thrives in exactly that kind of environment. This is not a steady-state recruiting role. You’ll be building pipelines in markets we’re entering for the first time, integrating talent from acquired companies, and hiring across both technical and non-technical functions as our needs evolve. You bring 3 to 5 years of full-cycle recruiting experience, a sharp instinct for technical talent, and the adaptability to shift priorities when the business does.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will be responsible for the following:

Technical Recruiting

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for technical roles including Software Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, Product, and DevOps across U.S. and international markets.
  • Build and maintain proactive talent pipelines for high-priority and hard-to-fill technical roles, reducing reliance on reactive sourcing.
  • Partner closely with Engineering and Product leadership to deeply understand team structures, technical stacks, and role requirements — translating that into compelling, accurate job positioning.
  • Develop and execute multi-channel sourcing strategies (LinkedIn, GitHub, direct outreach, niche communities, referrals) tailored to technical candidate personas.
  • Conduct candidate assessments that evaluate both technical fit and cultural alignment, partnering with hiring managers on structured interview design.

Full-Spectrum Hiring Support

  • Support hiring across GTM (Sales, Marketing, Customer Success), G&A, and Operations functions as business priorities shift.
  • Review resumes as well as conduct interviews and candidate screens to evaluate technical capabilities, soft skills, and overall cultural fit.
  • Flex across multiple open requisitions simultaneously, balancing technical and non-technical searches with strong prioritization and stakeholder communication.
  • Serve as a trusted recruiting partner to hiring managers across all functions, providing market insights, candidate feedback, and process guidance.

M&A / Integration Recruiting

  • Play an active role in talent integration during M&A activity, including assessment of acquired talent pools and backfill planning.
  • Partner with People Operations and business leadership to develop recruiting strategies that support smooth organizational integration post-acquisition.
  • Help identify role redundancies, gaps, and headcount needs arising from M&A activity in coordination with HR and Finance.

International Recruiting

  • Manage full-cycle recruiting for international roles with a working understanding of local hiring norms, market conditions, and candidate expectations.
  • Partner with People Operations on compliant job posting, offer structuring, and onboarding across different jurisdictions.
  • Build relationships with international sourcing channels, agencies, and talent communities relevant to our active markets.

ATS Ownership & Candidate Experience

  • Develop, maintain and continuously enhance all processes related to our applicant tracking system (ATS), including hiring manager guides, pipeline stages, application forms and questionnaires, feedback surveys, etc.
  • Set up all job requisitions and monitor candidate progress.
  • Maintain accurate, timely data within the ATS to ensure pipeline visibility and reporting integrity.
  • Track and report on key recruiting metrics including time-to-fill, source effectiveness, offer acceptance rate, and pipeline conversion.
  • Deliver a consistently excellent candidate experience at every stage — responsive communication, organized interview processes, and thoughtful feedback loops.
  • Identify and recommend process improvements to increase recruiting efficiency and quality of hire as the organization scales.

Requirements:

  • 3 to 5 years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with at least 2 years focused on technical roles (Engineering, Data, ML, or Product).
  • Demonstrated experience recruiting in a high-growth, fast-changing environment — SaaS, AI/ML, or enterprise tech strongly preferred.
  • Exposure to M&A recruiting or talent integration is a meaningful plus.
  • Experience recruiting for international roles or across multiple geographies.
  • Strong technical literacy — you don’t need to write code, but you can credibly discuss engineering roles, understand technical job requirements, and assess candidate fit with confidence.
  • Proficiency using various sourcing tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, SeekOut, GitHub, etc.) and in managing ATS platforms (preferably Rippling).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to represent Capacity compellingly; fluency in both English and Spanish is a plus.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, you manage multiple open roles and stakeholders without things falling through the cracks.
  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity; you can build structure where it doesn’t exist and adapt quickly when priorities shift.
  • Data-oriented — you track what matters, report accurately, and use metrics to continuously improve your approach.
  • Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, Communications, or related field, or equivalent experience preferred.

You are motivated by:

  • Hustle: You inspire others to work as hard as you. You will find a way, no matter how hard the task is.
  • Ownership: You have an owner/builder mentality. You care about what you deliver and own your mistakes.
  • Proactivity: You don’t wait for someone to tell you what to do or what problems to solve. You are always looking for ways to learn and improve.
  • Excellence: You set a high bar and surpass expectations. You hit your goals and ask for more.
  • Humility: You are not above any task in the organization and are willing to drop what you’re doing to help a teammate.

What you can expect from us

The team:

Capacity team members enjoy the opportunity and benefits of working at an artificial intelligence startup, but with leaders who’ve worked at places like Apple, Ebay, Visa, Answers.com, Oracle, Boeing, and many more world-class companies. The culture at Capacity encourages innovation, independent problem solving, and collaboration as we continue to mature our product in the ever-changing world of AI.

We provide:

  • Employer-paid health insurance (for you and your eligible dependents)
  • Profit Interest Units/incentive compensation
  • Unlimited vacation policy
  • 401(k) with a company match
  • Short term disability insurance
  • Group life AD&D insurance
  • A supportive, diverse workplace where we prioritize respect for each other and our clients
  • A fun and collaborative team culture

Salary range:

  • The expected base salary for the Global Recruiter role is between $90,000 and $105,000; actual salary will be commensurate with a candidate's experience, skill and location.

Still unsure?

At Capacity we value more than just hard skills. Our goal is to build a holistic and diverse team. If you aren’t sure if you qualify, just apply! We will carefully consider your application and are always grateful for any time and effort invested in Capacity.

But wait, there’s more!

At Capacity we believe in more than just building amazing products and helping our customers. Although we are a remote workforce, we remember the neighborhood where we started. We still strive to elevate our community by furthering access to education and careers in the tech space. Our affiliated nonprofit, Create A Loop, brings rigorous computer science courses to underserved communities with little to no access to formal computer science education. There are many opportunities for our Capacity team members to serve and educate our Create A Loop students throughout the year.

ControllerType: Full time
Location: Remote
Reports To: CEO
Department: Finance & Accounting

About Muddy Mat
Muddy Mat is the market leading pet friendly home products brand, best known for our ultra absorbent chenille door mats designed to trap mud, water, and dirt from pet paws and shoes. We sell across our own website, Amazon, Walmart.com, TikTok Shop, Chewy, and other digital channels. With over 50,000 five star reviews and a proven track record as a 9 figure direct to consumer brand, Muddy Mat has built massive product market fit across multiple digital channels. We move fast, we build for the long term, and we are now building the financial infrastructure to match our scale.

The Mission
This is not a "manage clean books" role. We are in the middle of a meaningful financial infrastructure upgrade — transitioning from cash basis to accrual accounting, migrating from QuickBooks Online to NetSuite, and preparing for a formal audit with a national CPA firm (BDO). We need someone who has done this before, who does not flinch at a cleanup project, and who can own the process end to end.
If you have inherited messy books and left them clean — this role was written for you.

What You'll Own
  • Lead and execute our transition from cash basis to accrual accounting, including restating historical financials and rebuilding the chart of accounts.
  • Own the migration from QuickBooks Online to NetSuite, partnering with our external NetSuite implementation consultant to ensure the system is configured correctly from day one.
  • Lead pre audit book cleanup in direct coordination with BDO, our external audit firm.
  • Own and manage the formal audit process from start to finish.
  • Own month end and year end close, ensuring accurate and timely financial statements.
  • Manage all aspects of the general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and payroll.
  • Build and maintain a strong internal controls environment to safeguard company assets.
  • Prepare and present monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports to the CEO and leadership team.
  • Identify and implement process improvements as we build a finance function that can scale.


What We're Looking For
Non negotiable:
  • Demonstrated experience transitioning a company from cash basis to accrual accounting — you have done this, recently, and can speak to it specifically.
  • Hands on experience with NetSuite — migration or implementation experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience working directly with an external audit firm on audit preparation and execution.
  • 7+ years of progressive accounting experience, with at least 2 years in a Controller or senior accounting role.
  • CPA designation (or local equivalent) strongly preferred.
  • Deep knowledge of US GAAP.
Strong preference — automatic interview:
  • Prior experience at a Big 4 firm (Deloitte, PwC, Ernst & Young, or KPMG) in audit or tax — Philippines, Latin America, or Eastern Europe specifically.
  • Experience in e commerce, DTC, or consumer products — multi channel revenue recognition is a plus.
  • Prior experience migrating from QuickBooks Online to an ERP system.
The person, not just the resume:
  • You are a builder, not a maintainer. You are energized by a blank whiteboard, not intimidated by it.
  • You communicate clearly with non finance stakeholders — you translate numbers into decisions, not just reports.
  • You are accountable. When something is wrong, you say so and fix it. You do not bury problems.

Why Muddy Mat
  • Real ownership. You will be the architect of our finance function — this is not a support role.
  • High visibility. Direct access to the CEO and leadership. Your work shapes decisions at the top.
  • Room to build. As we scale, you build the team under you.
  • Serious problem to solve. We are a 9 figure brand doing meaningful infrastructure work — the kind of challenge that sharpens careers.

About PSD Citywide

Ready to make a real impact on communities across North America?

PSD Citywide isn’t just a software company; we’re transforming how Local, First Nations, and Regional Governments achieve success and build sustainable futures for their communities. As a recognized leader in Enterprise Asset Management, maintenance management, and planning solutions, we provide cutting-edge software and expert advisory services that improve infrastructure and public services.

Why join us? We are a "Fun-clusive" organization! This means we intentionally foster a supportive and engaging culture where your contributions are celebrated, your skills are rewarded, and your career growth is encouraged. Ready to influence change? Bring your expertise in technology and data to our team and directly shape how local governments improve service delivery. Apply now!

Job Description

The Implementation Advisor will lead small to large multi-phase software implementation projects for municipal Building, Planning, and Community Development departments across North America. Working directly with local government staff, the Implementation Advisor will analyze permitting, licensing, inspection, and land-use workflows to design solutions that support efficient, transparent community development processes.

This role requires a strong ability to understand municipal operations, interpret business and data requirements, and translate them into effective system configurations. The Implementation Advisor will create and maintain project documentation, deliver training to end users, and collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful project outcomes. They must possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to clearly communicate solutions while adhering to project deliverables and timelines. This is a Full Time Remote position, the successful candidate must live in Canada.

Responsibilities & Duties

  • Act as Project Manager on small to large multi-phase software implementation projects for municipal Building and Planning departments.
  • Plan, track, and communicate throughout the implementation lifecycle, managing project constraints to achieve client success objectives.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to municipal clients, offering best-practice recommendations for permitting, inspections, planning workflows, and development review processes.
  • Facilitate requirements-gathering sessions with planners, inspectors, permit technicians, and administrative staff to identify business objectives and operational needs.
  • Provide software demonstrations tailored to municipal permitting, licensing, and land-use management use cases.
  • Create and maintain configuration, testing, process, and project documentation; configure model components based on municipal workflow analysis.
  • Analyze data sets related to permits, inspections, parcels, and planning applications to determine optimal configuration and migration strategies.
  • Deliver both synchronous and asynchronous end-user training for municipal staff, remotely or onsite as required.
  • Develop detailed written technical specifications for data imports/exports, custom routines, and support issues.
  • Utilize internal Project Management Software to manage the lifecycle of each implementation and prepare project reports and status updates.
  • Understand PSD’s product release and patch process and plan for potential impacts on municipal clients.
  • Participate in team status meetings, review JIRA tickets, collaborate on solutions, and prioritize requirements.
  • Escalate client issues to appropriate team members to ensure timely resolution.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • 3–5 years experience in a similar role implementing complex software modules or municipal technology solutions.
  • College Diploma or University Degree in Computer Science, Information Management, GIS, Urban Planning, Civil Engineering, Accounting, or a related field.
  • 2+ years experience applying standard software implementation techniques in a client-facing role, preferably with municipal or public-sector clients.
  • 3–5 years experience with project management tools, methodologies, and best practices.
  • Familiarity with cloud software environments and intermediate to advanced proficiency with modern technologies such as Google Suite, JIRA, Kantata, etc.
  • Experience working with municipal clients—especially Building, Planning, or Community Development departments—is a strong asset.
  • Knowledge and/or experience working with large data sets, including permitting, parcel, or land-use data.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and presentation skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to foster strong client relationships and guide municipal teams through change.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Growth-oriented and entrepreneurial mindset.
  • Valid driver’s license and passport for travel.
  • Advanced skills with MS Word and Excel.

What We Offer:

Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salaries that recognize your skills and experience
Wellness Coverage: Enjoy a comprehensive health and wellness benefits package that keeps you and your family secure and healthy.
Flexible Working: Work where you thrive! Enjoy remote work flexibility (specific regional options apply) while staying connected to our supportive team.
Work-Life Balance: Benefit from Flex Hours to manage your personal life and Paid Time Off (PTO) so you can fully recharge.
Unwind Early: Say hello to summer with our popular Summer Fridays—shorter work weeks to help you kick-start the weekend.
Culture & Community: Participate in fun social events (both virtual and in-person) and contribute to charity initiatives as part of our community focus.
Career Growth: Our Career Framework provides clear, structured paths for growth and ongoing learning, ensuring you reach your professional goals.

Candidate Journey

Resume Review: Once you apply, an actual person will review your resume and we are committed to getting back to you within three weeks with a response.

Phone Interview: PSD’s People and Culture team will connect with you to learn about your experience and discuss the role further. They’ll also give you an understanding of what the interview process involves, along with an estimated timeline.

Virtual Interview: Depending on the position, there will be one or two interviews with the Hiring Team that will include questions related to your skills, work experience, values and goals. We provide the opportunity to meet with a wide range of staff members so you can learn more about life at PSD Citywide.

Offer/Feedback: The Hiring Team will debrief and make a decision within a few days of your final interview. If successful, your Recruiter will present you with a verbal offer, followed by a formal offer letter via email. If the timing was not right for this particular opportunity, we will connect with you and provide feedback.

PSD Citywide is committed to ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. We believe in integration, and we are committed to meeting the needs of people with disabilities in a timely manner. We will do so by removing and preventing barriers to accessibility.

We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process. Should you require any accommodation, please indicate this when you apply, and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

PSD Citywide may use Google Gemini to assist with recruitment note taking during the hiring process. While we incorporate select AI features to enhance process efficiency, we remain committed to human-led decision making. All AI-generated outputs are subject to human review to ensure accuracy and fairness.

Salary: $80,000-$90,000

This is a senior leadership role for a commercially minded and hands-on marketing professional who can build marketing strategy, strengthen brand awareness, support product launches, and drive business growth within the B2B iGaming sector.

The successful candidate will play a key role in shaping the company's global marketing direction while working closely with Product, Commercial, and Leadership teams.

Important Industry Requirement

This role is strictly reserved for candidates with experience within the iGaming industry.

Candidates must have previous experience working for a Game Provider, Slot Provider, Casino Content Provider, Aggregator, or a closely related B2B iGaming business.

Applications from candidates whose experience is limited to operators, affiliates, agencies, or industries outside iGaming will only be considered if they can demonstrate substantial B2B game provider marketing experience.

Marketing Strategy & Leadership

  • Define and strengthen the company's brand positioning within the international iGaming market.

  • Establish, develop, and scale the marketing function in line with business objectives.

  • Create marketing processes, reporting structures, and KPI frameworks.

  • Manage and mentor internal marketing resources and external partners where required.

  • Align marketing initiatives with commercial and product objectives.

Brand Awareness & Demand Generation

  • Lead B2B marketing initiatives aimed at increasing brand awareness and market visibility.

  • Develop and execute PR, content, social media, and thought leadership strategies.

  • Strengthen the company's presence across key industry channels and publications.

  • Identify opportunities to enhance brand recognition among operators, aggregators, and industry stakeholders.

Product Marketing & Game Launches

  • Translate game mechanics, product features, and differentiators into compelling marketing materials.

das sind wir:

Lust auf eine Rolle, in der aktiv am Aufbau eines Partnernetzwerks im Healthcare-Umfeld mitgearbeitet wird?
Willkommen im Dental-Tech. Wir sind Patient21 und wir bringen Zahnarztpraxen digital ins 21. Jahrhundert. Neben unserer Software bauen wir ein starkes Ökosystem aus Partnern auf – von Plattformen über Dienstleister bis hin zu strategischen Kooperationen.
Für den weiteren Ausbau suchen wir Unterstützung im Bereich Business Development und Partnermanagement.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist?

Du baust etwas auf, das wirklich zählt – ein Partnernetzwerk, das Zahnarztpraxen in ganz Deutschland vernetzt und mit dem Unternehmen wächst.

Dabei entsteht ein breites Verständnis für Business Development, strategische Zusammenarbeit und operative Umsetzung – in einer Branche, die gerade erst beginnt, sich zu verändern.

wir bieten dir:

  • Eine steile Lernkurve durch echte Projekte und echte Verantwortung – kein Praktikumsprojekt, das in der Schublade landet
  • Direkter Zugang zu Sales, Marketing und Management – von Tag 1
  • Direkter Einfluss auf den Aufbau eines neuen Kanals – kein abgehobenes Strategieprojekt, sondern echte Umsetzung
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich mit Studium oder anderen Verpflichtungen kombinieren lassen
  • Die Chance, einen Kanal aufzubauen, der mit dem Unternehmen skaliert
  • Ein junges, unkompliziertes Team mit flachen Hierarchien und echter Hands-on-Kultur
  • Kostenlose Snackbar und Getränke im Büro
  • Unterstützung bei der Altersvorsorge und weitere Mitarbeiter-Benefits

angebot:

Der Job in a Nutshell

Du baust unser Netzwerk aus Vertriebspartnern und Resellern auf, entwickelst es weiter und erschließt damit zusätzliche Vertriebspotenziale.

Bei Patient21 digitalisieren wir das Gesundheitswesen – mit einem Plattformansatz aus ganzheitlicher Software und ineinandergreifenden Services, die wir Zahnarztpraxen in ganz Deutschland anbieten.

Jetzt suchen wir jemanden, der unser Partnerökosystem von Grund auf mitgestaltet.

Ideal auch für Werkstudent:innen mit Interesse an Business Development & Partnerschaften.

aufgaben:

  • Identifikation und Recherche relevanter Partner im Dental- und Healthcare-Umfeld
  • Ansprache potenzieller Partner über verschiedene Kanäle
  • Mitarbeit bei der Entwicklung und Strukturierung von Partnerstrategien
  • Mitarbeit bei der Umsetzung von Kooperationsprojekten
  • Pflege und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Partnerbeziehungen
  • Dokumentation und Pflege aller Aktivitäten im CRM

was erwartet dich:

  • Du recherchierst, wer im Dental- und Healthcare-Umfeld als Partner Sinn ergibt – und gehst dann aktiv auf sie zu
  • Du hilfst dabei, Partnerstrategien zu strukturieren, Kooperationen umzusetzen und bestehende Beziehungen weiterzuentwickeln
  • Kein klassischer Sales-Job, sondern ein Mix aus Business Development und Projektarbeit – mit direktem Einfluss auf den Aufbau eines neuen Kanals
  • Du arbeitest direkt mit Sales, Marketing und Management zusammen – und hältst deine Aktivitäten sauber im CRM fest

was bringst du mit:

  • Strukturierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise
  • Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und sicheres Auftreten
  • Interesse an B2B, Partnerschaften und Geschäftsmodellen
  • Erste Erfahrungen im Bereich Business Development, Projektmanagement oder verwandten Bereichen von Vorteil
  • Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Tools und idealerweise erste CRM-Erfahrung
  • Deutsch Muttersprache und gute Englischkenntnisse

klingt das spannend?

Dann melde dich mit Lebenslauf, LinkedIn-Profil oder kurzer Nachricht.
